title: TCI Europe N.V.
content:
TCI Europe is a Belgium-based distributor of laboratory and specialty chemicals serving academic and industrial research markets across Europe. It distributes aerogel-related materials as part of a broader advanced-materials catalog.

  • Coverage Area: Belgium and Europe-wide distribution
  • Focus Areas: Specialty chemicals, research materials, nanomaterials, silica aerogel products, and laboratory supply
  • Current Brands Represented: TCI catalog products and sourced specialty aerogel materials
  • Official Website: https://www.tcichemicals.com/
review_notes: 2026-08 verified: tcieurope.com consolidated into global tcichemicals.com web presence; TCI Europe N.V. remains the Zwijndrecht, Belgium entity.
